cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.25)
project(RoModularBoardFixture LANGUAGES CXX ASM)
if(NOT ROMODULAR_SOURCE_DIR)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Set ROMODULAR_SOURCE_DIR to the RoModularBuild checkout")
endif()
include("${ROMODULAR_SOURCE_DIR}/cmake/boards/STM32G0B1CBT6.cmake")
add_executable(BoardFixture main.cpp)
target_compile_features(BoardFixture PRIVATE cxx_std_11)
target_compile_options(BoardFixture PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Werror -Os)
romodular_configure_stm32g0b1cbt6(BoardFixture)
